title: I made a castle defense game just to play with my friends. Should I put it out there?
author: virtualbudz
selftext:
I made this game so I could play locally with my friends. Honestly it's pure nostalgia for me, and that's why my friends and I play it.

Now I'm not sure what to do with it. Upload it? Let other people play? Add the 3v3 PvP mode I've been messing with?

It's not perfect. Around level 30 things flatten out, so I think I need a version 2 for my friends to keep it fun, with more boss battles, skill tree upgrades and stuff.

If you want to know how I made it, the pixel art, the animations or anything else, just ask.

A few questions for you:

1. Is CrazyGames good enough for hosting, especially for multiplayer?

2. How do you do pixel art for small characters? For the slightly bigger ones it was easy with ChatGPT's image generator, but the small ones are hard.

3. For particles and special effects (fire, ice, explosions, spell effects), is there a good repo, library or "best way" you'd recommend? It's a browser game built with three.js, pixel-art style.



Some things I learned along the way:

\- I made a special character called Archon just to test the limits of the animations. Having one hero to try everything on made it easy.

\- I also tried video generators for pixel art animation. My tip: be consistent. Use images OR video for a character's frames, not both. If you merge them, it's obvious.

\- I even tried making AI videos of a real person doing the moves (kicks, shield bash, backflips), tracking their body, and using that motion to animate my characters. It didn't work out at all for my sprites. For now, coding the animations works way better. Happy to explain more.

comments.author: abgriff
comments.body: I th ink it looks good, I would try it out. I can't answer any of your questions though.
